title: Grateful Dead Live at University of Iowa on 1973-02-24
lineage: Partial Set I - Last four songs SBD> MR> DAT> CDR

ai_review.summary: Excellent soundboard capture of a scorching 'Playing in the Band' fragment from early‑’73 Iowa, with crystal‑clear mix and blazing band performance.
ai_review.review: The recording is praised for its A+ sound quality – crisp, balanced, and even puts Kreutzman's cymbals right up in your face.  Musically it delivers a barn‑burning version of "Playing in the Band" that many reviewers call peak form, with hot jams from Truckin' through Eyes of the World into Sugar Magnolia despite being only a fragment of the full show.

ai_rating.rationale: Over twenty enthusiastic reviews uniformly award 4–5 stars, highlighting both superb soundboard quality and an outstanding performance; the weight of positive commentary yields a rating in the high‑four range.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Listeners repeatedly note A+ clarity, crisp mix, strong presence on drums and vocals, no reported dropouts or major flaws.

standout_songs: Truckin' > Nobody's Fault But Mine > Eyes Of The World > Sugar Magnolia
show_quality.setlist_flow: Even as a fragment, the set flows with high energy – a fiery first‑set climax on "Playing in the Band" followed by an inspired second‑set jam that showcases the band's improvisational peak of early ’73.

band_member_comments.Jerry: Garcia’s playing is described as "hot", with his solo reaching a wawa-like intensity and exploring uncharted territory.
band_member_comments.Phil: Phil’s bass channel mix is noted in a technical discussion, but no direct performance comment beyond the overall band excellence.
band_member_comments.Drums: Kreutzman's cymbals are praised for being "right up in your face", indicating a powerful drum presence.
